In detail

Berruguete has a recurring pattern of resident complaints about insecurity, noise and cleanliness, including witnessed robberies and late-night disturbances tied to a nightlife venue with numerous licensing infractions. These complaints recur across several years, suggesting a persistent but moderate, localized concern. Sources checked: El Distrito, Oct 2021; Tetuan30dias.com; Decide Madrid citizen proposals.
